texts.title: Riverside Rowing Club — course for beginners

paragraphs.text: Our beginners’ course runs for six Saturday mornings from 10 am to midday. It is open to adults of all fitness levels, but everyone must be able to swim 50 metres.
The course costs £90, which includes the use of boats and life jackets. Participants should wear sports clothes that are not too loose and bring a bottle of water.
In the first session, you will learn basic safety rules and practise on rowing machines in the clubhouse before going out on the river.
Sessions may be cancelled if the river is too high after heavy rain. In this case, the club will send a text message by 8 am and the session will be added to the end of the course.
Anyone who completes the course can join the club at a reduced membership rate for the first year. Members can book boats online and take part in friendly races with other clubs.

document.title: Riverside Rowing Club — course for beginners

items.quote: Our beginners’ course runs for six Saturday mornings
items.prompt: On which day of the week does the course take place?

explanation.en: “runs for six Saturday mornings” → Saturday. The question asks for the day, not the number of sessions.
explanation.kk: «runs for six Saturday mornings» → Saturday. Сабақ саны емес, апта күні сұралады.
explanation.ru: «runs for six Saturday mornings» → Saturday. Спрашивают день недели, а не количество занятий.

items.quote: everyone must be able to swim 50 metres
items.prompt: How far must participants be able to swim?

explanation.en: “everyone must be able to swim 50 metres” → 50 metres. 10 am is the start time.
explanation.kk: «everyone must be able to swim 50 metres» → 50 metres. 10 am — басталу уақыты.
explanation.ru: «everyone must be able to swim 50 metres» → 50 metres. 10 am — время начала.

items.quote: which includes the use of boats and life jackets
items.prompt: Apart from boats, what does the price include?

explanation.en: “includes the use of boats and life jackets” → life jackets. The water bottle is brought by participants, not included.
explanation.kk: «includes the use of boats and life jackets» → life jackets. Бір бөтелке суды қатысушылар өздері әкеледі — бағаға кірмейді.
explanation.ru: «includes the use of boats and life jackets» → life jackets. Бутылку воды участники приносят сами — это не входит в цену.

items.quote: practise on rowing machines in the clubhouse
items.prompt: What do beginners practise on before going out on the river?

explanation.en: “practise on rowing machines in the clubhouse” → rowing machines. “Clubhouse” is where; the question asks “on what”.
explanation.kk: «practise on rowing machines in the clubhouse» → rowing machines. «Clubhouse» — қайда, ал сұрақ «on what».
explanation.ru: «practise on rowing machines in the clubhouse» → rowing machines. «Clubhouse» — где, а вопрос «on what».

items.quote: the club will send a text message by 8 am
items.prompt: How will the club tell participants that a session has been cancelled?

explanation.en: “the club will send a text message by 8 am” → text message. “A text message” is three words, over the limit.
explanation.kk: «the club will send a text message by 8 am» → text message. «A text message» — үш сөз, шектен асады.
explanation.ru: «the club will send a text message by 8 am» → text message. «A text message» — три слова, больше лимита.
